description: This file defines the ResponseInterface in the PSR HTTP Message standard, which specifies the interface for server-side HTTP responses, including methods for obtaining and setting status codes, reason phrases, headers, and message bodies.

classes.name: ResponseInterface
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of an HTTP response, including methods to retrieve and modify status code, reason phrase, headers, and message body while maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the response's status code.
